parties.heading: Parties and Work
parties.text: This Agreement No. LWE-A-2012-01 is made on 14 September 2012 between Cassia Merrowby ("the Grantor", also called the Author) and Lantern Wharf Editions of 3 Tallow Steps, Port Alder ("the Publisher"), concerning the work titled "The Salt Ledger" (ISBN 979-8-9001-0000-5) ("the Work").

grant.heading: Grant of Rights
grant.text: The Grantor grants to the Publisher the exclusive right to publish the Work in the English language, in the following territory: the world, in the following formats: paperback and ebook.

term.heading: Term
term.text: This grant of rights continues for the full term of copyright.

royalties.heading: Royalties
royalties.text: The Publisher shall pay the Grantor royalties of 10 percent of net receipts on paperback sales and 25 percent of net receipts on ebook sales. Royalties are accounted for twice a year.

subsidiary.heading: Subsidiary Rights
subsidiary.text: Serial, anthology and audio rights are held by the Publisher, with proceeds divided equally between the Author and the Publisher.

reversion.heading: Reversion
reversion.text: If the Work is out of print in all formats granted in Clause 2, the Grantor may request in writing that the rights revert. If, within six (6) months after the Publisher's receipt of that written request, the Publisher has not made the Work available again in at least one format granted in Clause 2, all rights granted under this Agreement revert to the Grantor automatically and without further notice. The Work is out of print when no edition of it is available for sale through ordinary trade channels. A print-on-demand edition listed with the Publisher's distributor counts as available.

permissions.heading: Permissions
permissions.text: The Publisher may grant permission to reprint single poems or extracts of up to fifty lines from the Work in anthologies, only with the prior written consent of the Author. Permission fees are divided equally between the Author and the Publisher.

warranties.heading: Warranties and Credit
warranties.text: The Grantor warrants that the Grantor holds the rights granted and that the Work does not infringe any third-party right. The Publisher shall credit the Grantor on every edition of the Work.

law.heading: Governing Law
law.text: This Agreement is governed by the law of the Republic of Harrowmere, an invented jurisdiction used for this fixture.

parties.heading: Parties and Work
parties.text: This Agreement No. LWE-T-2014-01 is made on 9 June 2014 between Estate of Teodoro Vasconcelo-Reis, represented by Lucia Vasconcelo-Reis, executor ("the Grantor", also called the Rights Holder) and Lantern Wharf Editions of 3 Tallow Steps, Port Alder ("the Publisher"), concerning the work titled "The Drowned Orchard" (ISBN 979-8-9001-0411-9) ("the Work"), being an English-language translation from the Portuguese by Wren Tallowfield ("the Translator").

grant.heading: Grant of Rights
grant.text: The Grantor grants to the Publisher the exclusive right to publish the Work in the English language, in the following territory: the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Ireland, Australia and New Zealand, in the following formats: paperback and ebook.

term.heading: Term
term.text: This grant of rights continues for ten years from first publication, renewable by written agreement.

royalties.heading: Royalties
royalties.text: The Publisher shall pay the Grantor royalties of 7 percent of net receipts on all sales, paid to the Rights Holder, with 2 percent of net receipts paid to the Translator. Royalties are accounted for twice a year.

subsidiary.heading: Subsidiary Rights
subsidiary.text: Anthology and serial rights in the English translation are held by the Publisher, with proceeds divided equally between the Rights Holder and the Translator.

engagement.heading: Translator's Engagement
engagement.text: The Publisher engages the Translator to prepare the English translation and shall pay the Translator a fee of USD 1,800, half on signature and half on delivery and acceptance of the manuscript. The Translator signs this Agreement to confirm the engagement and to confirm that the translation is the Translator's own work.
